messages:
sam: Quick heads upFjordML needs a compact perf readout for a conversational+embed rerank POC. They want sustained 300 qps, microbursts to 1200 qps, and clear cold vs warm comparisons. Can we run Tue AM?

leah: Tue AM good. Confirming targets: p95_chat <= 250ms, p95_embed <= 400ms?

sam: Exactly. Traffic mix ~70% chat, 30% embed. Include runs: (1) cold start, no cache, batching minimal; (2) warmed cache + batching. Capture p50/p95/p99, gpu util, batch distribution, kv_cache_hit, tokens/sec.

mike: Add instrumentation: route, model_variant, batch_size, client_retry_count, request_token_count, client-side vs server-side latency. Also mark when microbursts start/stop.

zara: Recommend testing with 70b-quant and a secondary 13b for cost-quality tradeoffs. Warm run should include 10m priming.

bench-bot: bench-deploy started by zara  id=bench-5123456789-1

jordan: Security asks from FjordML: 7d log retention, KMS for customer keys, SCIM SSO, and a short note on tenant isolation/egress. I can draft a 1-paragraph response.

leah: I'll prepare a runbook snippet and vegeta snippets for chat+embed. We'll run one baseline without client retries and one with exponential-backoff to mimic SDK retries.

bench-bot: Run1 (cold) snapshot: p50_chat=130ms, p95_chat=510ms, p99_chat=1.05s, p95_embed=900ms, avg_batch=1.5, gpu_util=58%
bench-bot: Run2 (warm, cache+batch): p50_chat=90ms, p95_chat=220ms, p99_chat=445ms, p95_embed=330ms, avg_batch=5.0, gpu_util=79%

mike: Good signal. Warm config cuts chat p95 ~2.3x and embed p95 ~2.7x. Bursts in cold run show transient 1.7-2x tail amplification in first 8-12s. Warm run handled microbursts with <1.2x transient.

sam: Action items: mike -> charts + per-1M-token cost delta; jordan -> security blurb; leah -> runbook + reproducer; zara -> include 13b comparison numbers. Deliverable: 1-page readout + 2 charts by EOD Monday.

leah: noted. I'll attach vegeta commands and a minimal priming script.

sam: thanks all  will schedule the customer readout Wed morning. :thumbsup:
